Image to ASCII Art

Turn any photo into ASCII art — sample real pixel brightness, tweak width, contrast and character set, then copy or download the text.


  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Upload an image.
  2. Set the output width in characters and pick a character ramp.
  3. Adjust brightness/contrast if the art looks flat.
  4. Copy the ASCII art or download it as a .txt file.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does it actually look like my image?
Characters are picked by real sampled brightness from your image, so the art genuinely resembles the photo.
Which character sets are available?
Standard ramps from sparse to dense, an inverted ramp for dark backgrounds, and a blocks-only set.
Why does it need a monospace font?
Monospace fonts (like the preview) line characters up in a grid. Proportional fonts break the art.
Is my image uploaded?
No — conversion happens entirely in your browser.
